'''Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War''' is the unreleased Original-era plan '''Galaxy At War''' (redirect from [[Virtual Set 19 (Cancelled)]]). A Polish fan overview of Star Wars CCG Virtual Sets marks this entry as ''niewydany'' (unreleased) &mdash; the only Virtual Set row so marked on that inventory. No standalone release PDF is known.

This is a different product from modern [[Virtual Set 19]] (Current Virtual, August 2022). Do not merge the two. Do not invent a card list.

Hub and sources: [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]] (&sect; Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War). Related era context: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]], [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]] (do not equate Galaxy At War with Fifth Anthology / VS18).
